title: Role of Contrast Enhanced Digital Mammography in Female Patients With Pathological Nipple Discharge
brief_summary: To evaluate the validity of contrast enhanced digital mammography in evaluation of pathological nipple discharge .
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1\_in diagnosis of female patients with pathological nipple discharge
